n:Arab Italian Bank (UBAE): Arab Italian Bank (UBAE) is a bank, and one person links it to the Central Bank of Libya. Saleh Ahmed Keshlaf joined the Central Bank of Libya in 1985 and was Director of the Governor's Office there from 1999 to 2012, and again from 2024. Between 2005 and 2012 he also sat on the board of Arab Italian Bank (UBAE).
n:Barings LLC: Barings LLC is a firm that invests money for clients. Timor-Leste's central bank, the Banco Central de Timor-Leste, is the operational manager of the country's Petroleum Fund and hires outside firms to run parts of it. Its quarterly report for 30 June 2025 lists Barings as the manager of the Barings LLC 1-10 years US TIPS mandate, and says the outside managers' investments stayed within their mandates during the quarter.
n:Empowerment Elimination, Anti-Corrupti: The Empowerment Elimination, Anti-Corruption and Funds Recovery Committee, in Khartoum, was set up by Sudan's transitional government. Radio Dabanga reported on 9 February 2020 that the committee dissolved the board of directors of the Central Bank of Sudan, along with the boards of eleven other banks, and that nine of the central bank's managers were dismissed at the same time. The reason given was the bank's alleged links to the deposed government of Omar Al Bashir, an allegation that remains unproven. No individual board member was named.
n:Franklin Templeton: Franklin Templeton invests money on behalf of clients. The Banco Central de Timor-Leste runs the country's Petroleum Fund day to day and hands parts of it to outside firms. The bank's quarterly report for 30 June 2025 lists Franklin Templeton as the manager of the Franklin Templeton 1-10 years US TIPS mandate, and records that the outside managers' investments stayed within their mandates over the quarter.
Goldman Sachs Asset Management L.P. invests money on behalf of clients. Banco de la Republica, Colombia's central bank, names it in its reserves management report as one of the seven outside firms each running a dedicated actively managed portfolio of Colombia's international reserves, the foreign money the central bank keeps in hand, at 31 December 2024.
n:JPMorgan Asset Management (UK) Limited: JPMorgan Asset Management (UK) Limited, in the United Kingdom, invests money on behalf of clients. Banco de la Republica, Colombia's central bank, hands part of the country's foreign reserves to outside firms to invest actively on its behalf, and its reserves management report names this firm as one of the seven firms holding such a dedicated portfolio at 31 December 2024.
n:Joumhourria Bank: Joumhourria Bank is linked to the Central Bank of Libya through one career record. Saleh Ahmed Keshlaf, at the Central Bank of Libya from 1985 and Director of the Governor's Office there from 1999 to 2012 and again from 2024, was a member of Joumhourria Bank's supervisory committee from 2012 to 2022.
n:Libyan Financial Services Company: The Libyan Financial Services Company appears here because of one person's career. Saleh Ahmed Keshlaf spent his working life at the Central Bank of Libya, which he joined in 1985, serving as Director of the Governor's Office from 1999 to 2012 and again from 2024. For much of that time, from 2009 to 2024, he was Deputy Chairman of the Libyan Financial Services Company.
n:Libyan Foreign Bank: The Libyan Foreign Bank is tied to the Central Bank of Libya through one career. Saleh Ahmed Keshlaf, who joined the Central Bank of Libya in 1985 and was Director of the Governor's Office there from 1999 to 2012 and again from 2024, was a member of the Libyan Foreign Bank's supervisory committee from 2007 to 2012.
n:National Bank of Serbia vaults, Belgra: This is the National Bank of Serbia's own vault space in Belgrade, where the bank keeps its gold rather than leaving it with anyone abroad. Its annual report for 2024 sets out the make-up of the foreign exchange reserves at 31 December 2024 as foreign securities at 59.16 percent, money in accounts abroad at 22.04 percent, gold in the bank's vaults at 13.26 percent, and foreign cash and special drawing rights. The whole of the gold holding sits in those vaults. This is storage, not management.
n:Produbanco: Produbanco, formally Banco de la Produccion S.A., is a bank in Ecuador. Juan Diego Mosquera Pesantes has been a director and board member of it since 2014. The curriculum vitae Produbanco publishes for him records that in 1981 he was a delegate and member of the Monetary Board at the Banco Central del Ecuador, and that he had earlier been the founding manager of Citibank Quito and a manager of Banco del Azuay.
UBS Asset Management (Americas) Inc. is an asset manager, meaning a firm that invests money on behalf of clients. Banco de la Republica, Colombia's central bank, hands part of the country's international reserves, the foreign money a central bank keeps in hand, to outside firms to invest actively for it. The bank's reserves management report names this firm as one of seven outside firms each running a dedicated actively managed portfolio of those reserves at 31 December 2024.
n:UBS Asset Management (UK) Ltd: UBS Asset Management (UK) Ltd, at 5 Broadgate in London, invests money on behalf of clients. The Central Bank of Ireland ran a public tender, reference 2022P012, to appoint an investment manager for the bank's own portfolio of shares, and the Irish contract award notice names this firm as the contractor, for a contract valued at 10 million euro excluding value added tax.
n:Wellington Management Company LLP: Wellington Management Company LLP is a firm that invests money for clients. Part of Colombia's international reserves is run this way: the reserves management report of Banco de la Republica, the country's central bank, names Wellington as one of seven outside firms each running a dedicated actively managed portfolio of those reserves at 31 December 2024, which means the firm buys and sells on the central bank's behalf rather than simply holding what it is given.
